prompt: Find the latest stable Morrow SDK as of 2026-11-20, and say whether the vendor's social team called that exact version stable. Work entirely from the local replay in replay.md and pages/. Use file reads only. Never invoke a search script, proxy health check, browser, network client or real endpoint, even if a workflow normally calls for one. Return a bare JSON object with next_step (one replay action ID for each of the SDK and social tickets, keyed sdk and social), version (no leading v), release_date (ISO date), channel (lowercase), source_url, and social_confirmation (confirmed, contradicted or unverified). Pick actions you would use after reading the two initial responses; don't execute them.
terse: Search when you have no URL. Use X search for X posts, and prefer library documentation tools for API questions. Once you have a promising result, fetch the source and verify the specific claim there instead of relying on the snippet.
